semantics.production_defect: fixed ode_steps per model call; direct and composed paths do not receive equal total RK4 work
semantics.equal_work_defect: base-step matched; direct and composed paths receive the same total RK4 substep count
semantics.sweep: one checkpoint reused for all ode_steps; no retraining

formal_metrics.semigroup_defect_semantics: legacy alias for numerical_semigroup_defect_mse; not an exact-flow guarantee
formal_metrics.numerical_semigroup_defect_semantics: production_fixed_ode_steps: every direct/composed model call uses model.ode_steps; a two-call composition therefore receives twice the RK4 work of its direct counterpart
formal_metrics.numerical_semigroup_relative_denominator: L2 norm of direct output, clamped below at 1e-12
formal_metrics.learned_energy_semantics: model.energy; not assumed to equal physical PDE energy
formal_metrics.learned_energy_positive_increment_semant: max(E[k+1] - E[k], 0) per valid sample-step transition; computed without the 1e-6 monotonicity tolerance
formal_metrics.physical_energy_positive_increment_seman: max(E_physical[k+1] - E_physical[k], 0) per valid sample-step transition; computed without the 1e-6 monotonicity tolerance
formal_metrics.equal_work_semigroup_defect_semantics: equal_work_base_step: for pair (i,j), direct uses (i+j)*base_ode_steps RK4 substeps and composition uses i*base_ode_steps followed by j*base_ode_steps; total work matches

formal_details.energy_positive_increment_semantics: per-step mean of max(E[k+1] - E[k], 0) over valid sample transitions; NaN marks an unavailable step

ode_steps_sweep.semantics: same checkpoint reused; only ode_steps changes temporarily; no retraining
